REF_WHO_ILI.title: WHO Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System (GISRS) Case Definitions for ILI
REF_WHO_ILI.description: Standardized clinical case definition for influenza-like illness (ILI): acute respiratory infection with measured fever of >= 38 C and cough, with onset within the last 10 days.

REF_CDC_COLD.title: Common Colds: Protect Yourself and Others
REF_CDC_COLD.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
REF_CDC_COLD.description: Clinical overview of viral upper respiratory tract infections highlighting nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, sore throat, and mild cough typically in the absence of high fever.

REF_AAAI_ALLERGY.title: Allergic Rhinitis Practice Parameters
REF_AAAI_ALLERGY.organization: American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (AAAAI)
REF_AAAI_ALLERGY.description: Diagnostic indicators for allergic rhinitis: paroxysmal sneezing, clear rhinorrhea, nasal itching, itchy/watery eyes, absence of fever or infectious prodrome.

REF_IHS_MIGRAINE.title: International Classification of Headache Disorders (ICHD-3)
REF_IHS_MIGRAINE.description: Diagnostic criteria for migraine without aura: recurrent headache disorder manifesting in attacks lasting 4-72 hours, typically unilateral, pulsating, moderate or severe, aggravated by physical activity, accompanied by nausea/vomiting and/or photophobia and phonophobia.

REF_ACG_GASTRO.title: Clinical Guideline: Diagnosis, Treatment, and Prevention of Acute Diarrheal Infections in Adults
REF_ACG_GASTRO.description: Clinical pattern of acute infectious gastroenteritis presenting with acute onset of diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal cramping.

REF_EAU_UTI.title: EAU Guidelines on Urological Infections
REF_EAU_UTI.description: Clinical presentation of uncomplicated lower urinary tract infection (cystitis): dysuria, urinary frequency, urinary urgency, suprapubic tenderness in the absence of vaginal symptoms or systemic fever.

REF_EMERGENCY_RED_FLAGS.title: Emergency Medicine Clinical Practice Guidelines: Red Flag Symptom Recognition
REF_EMERGENCY_RED_FLAGS.description: Clinical triage indicators representing immediate potential threats to life or limb requiring urgent emergency medical evaluation.
